lines: +    """Allocate DDP grad buffers without a torch-memory-saver CPU backup.
+    In colocate mode the trainer is paused (torch_memory_saver.pause) between
+    the optimizer step and the next rollout. Grad buffers are dead at that
+    point: the optimizer step consumed them and the next train step zeroes
+    them before backward (`_zero_grads` in model.py). Backing ~30 GB of fp32
+    main grads up to host memory and restoring them on wake is pure overhead
+    (tens of seconds per step). Param buffers keep their backup (they hold
+    the live weights). Idempotent; only takes effect once.
+        ddp_config = kwargs.get("ddp_config", args[0] if args else None)
+    logger.info("Patched _ParamAndGradBuffer.__init__ for colocate mode (no grad-buffer cpu backup)")
